description: Sleep for one night (stages, score, overnight heart rate, respiration) or, with an end_date, a nightly summary per day across a range. A night is filed under the date you woke up.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

start_date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: get_sleep
title: Sleep
